notes.content:
Yunhe Dreamcatcher Gift Box Now Available

· The Yunhe Dreamcatcher Gift Box will be available for a limited time after maintenance on September 11, 2025. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

· The gift box contains the Doodle Combat Background "Hide-and-Seek Planet," Card Back "Bamboo Shadows," "Doodle Alternative Art Selection Box," "Yunhe Dreamcatcher Title Selection Box," and "Secret Scroll Selection Box" ×5.

· Guests can use the "Yunhe Dreamcatcher Title Selection Box" to choose one of the following Titles to add to their collection: "Golden Brotherhood," "Dancing in Finery," or "Blossoming Together."

· Guests can use the "Doodle Alternative Art Selection Box" to choose any set of Doodle Alternative Art released before August 27, 2025 to add to their collection.

You can also choose the "Cloud River Dream Gathering Friendship Set," which allows you to gift a "Graffiti Alternative Art Selection Gift Box" and a "Cloud River Dream Gathering Title Selection Gift Box" to a friend. (Cannot be gifted again after sending)

Voyage Pass: S8 Now Available

· Available Time: From after the maintenance on September 11, 2025.

· Guests can spend 248 Jade to purchase the Voyage Pass: S8. Once purchased, Voyage Pass: S8 will be instantly leveled up to Lv.9, allowing guests to immediately earn all exclusive Doodle Alternative Art of the current Voyage Pass: Doodle Alternative Art for Hakuzosu: Tempered Heart's base Shikigami and its full set of 8 cards, along with the corresponding 9 Ink Splash Card Frames.

· The Voyage Pass has a total of 30 levels. Guests can earn points by completing the specified point quests to level up the Voyage Pass. Claim corresponding rewards once the Voyage Pass reaches a certain level. Each reward can only be claimed once.

· Guests can directly purchase levels for the Voyage Pass at a cost of 3 Jade per level. Please spend money responsibly.

The Flowers of Love Qixi Event Is Now Available!

Event Time: From after the maintenance on September 11, 2025 to 24:00 on September 24, 2025.

Event Description:

· During the event, guests can obtain Flowers by completing event quests.

· Guests can arrange flowers to create and gift bouquets favored by Shikigami. Upon success, you can earn Alternation Omnius Secret Scrolls, Ink Jade, Glass Stone, and Refined Stone as rewards.

· Players can repeatedly gift their preferred bouquets to Shikigami, and each gift will grant a Gold reward.

· After the event ends, the two Shikigami who received the most bouquets from players will send thank-you emails containing Alternation Omnius Secret Scroll rewards. (You must send at least 3 bouquets)

Doodle Alternative Art Limited-time Rerun

· Rerun Period: From after maintenance on September 11, 2025 to 23:59 on September 24, 2025.

· This rerun includes the following Doodle Alternative Art: "Shinkiro Doodle Alternative Art."

Alternative Art Takes Turns to Discount: Thirtieth Turn Begins

· Many Alternative Arts which have been sold for over one year will enjoy a discount for a limited time during each turn, guests can head to the Alternative Art Shop to purchase them! 

· Event Time: From 10:00 on September 11, 2025 to 9:00 on October 30, 2025. 

· This round's Alternative Art: "Ungaikyo: Mirror of the Alley," "Momo: Abundance," "Langyazi: Miracle Elixir," "Hiyoribou: Sunny Heartbeat Sake," "Sparrow: Cat on the Trip," "Kurumi: Fragrant Dye."

· The "Starry Strategy Reinforce Card Exclusive Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. The gift box contains 35 Starry Strategy Secret Scrolls and a random Starry Strategy SSR card gift box.

· The "Stellar Strategy Reinforce Card Premium Gift Box" will be available at the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. The gift box includes 50 Stellar Strategy Card Packs and a random Stellar Strategy SSR Card Gift Box.

【Reinforce Card Acquisition Event - Dreaming of Flowers Begins】

· Event Time: From 10:00 on June 19, 2025, to 24:00 on July 16, 2025.

· Event Description:

  During the event, players can claim 10 "Reinforce Points" daily from the event interface.

  Players can earn an additional 10 "Reinforce Points" for each match victory, with a daily limit of 40 points (applicable to Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Match/Investigation Society/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess).

  Players can earn 20 "Reinforce Points" by making their first recharge of any amount each day.

  Accumulating "Reinforce Points" allows guests to obtain SSR Reinforce Cards, corresponding Shikigami SR cards, 14-day trial cards for the Shikigami, Starbound Strategies Card Packs, and other rewards on the event page.

· Event Notice

  Players can claim Reinforce Points on the event page after daily login. Each player can claim up to 10 points per day. The claimable Reinforce Points will refresh daily at 00:00. Please remember to claim your points in time.

  Guests can earn 10 Reinforce Points each time they win in Ranked Match/Player Match/Game/Investigation Club/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess daily. Each guest can complete this task up to 4 times per day, and the task will refresh daily at 0:00.

  Players will earn 20 Reinforce points for their first top-up of any amount each day, and the first top-up will reset at 00:00 daily.

· The reward claim page will close along with the event page at 24:00 on July 16, 2025. Unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.

· Guests who did not obtain Reinforce cards during the event can still synthesize Reinforce cards later using Talismans.

【Mirage Chronicles Gameplay Unlocked】

· Permanent PVE Gameplay: Mirage Deep Records is now open! Guests can participate in the gameplay at Shotengai Sparrow.

· In the Mirage Deep Record, players will take on the role of different Players as collectors of ghost stories, challenging various levels to gather ghost story information and complete the "Mirage Deep Record."

· Guests, playing as the player, will use a fixed deck to take on challenges.

· During each challenge, players will engage in several consecutive battles against AI decks. After each battle, players will restore all Health and receive deck enhancements.

· Players will receive a certain number of Revive attempts during challenges, which can be used to retry the challenge upon failure.

· Guests will receive a certain number of refresh attempts during challenges. When randomly refreshing selectable content, they can consume refresh attempts to re-roll options.

Mechanic - Player Level

· Players, as the role of the Player, will gain EXP based on challenge progress, allowing them to level up.

· Upgraded players will unlock various abilities beneficial for subsequent challenges, including "Initial Stats Boost," "Initial Spirit Blessing," "Initial Treasure," "Initial Equipment," and "Card Upgrades."

Mechanism - Equipment

· "Equipment" is an item that can be equipped by Shikigami in the deck.

· "Equipment" has various effects that activate when the equipped Shikigami meets certain conditions.

· Players can obtain "Equipment" both inside and outside the challenges of the Mirage Deep Record.

Mechanic - Card Upgrade

· Players can upgrade all 32 cards of the 4 Shikigami in their deck, with each card having two upgrade levels. (Reinforce cards are not included.)

· Players can obtain "Card Upgrades" both inside and outside the challenges of the Mirage Deep Record.

Mechanism - Treasure

· Players can obtain "Treasure" cards with various powerful effects both inside and outside challenges to enhance their deck strength.

Mechanic - Spirit Blessing

· Now, upon obtaining "Spiritual Aid," abilities are directly granted without relying on layer count for acquisition or upgrades.

· Obtaining duplicate "Spiritual Aid" still allows for ability upgrades.

· In the Mirage Chronicles, players can enhance their deck in various ways during combat breaks.

Stages and Difficulty

· As exploration progresses, the difficulty of the levels encountered by players will gradually increase.

· Each level has five difficulty settings. Completing each difficulty will unlock ghost stories in the Mirage Deep Record.

· Higher difficulty levels will result in opponents having more cards, stronger abilities, and certain initial value bonuses. Please prepare your player for cultivation accordingly.

· Various content for the Mirage Deep Record gameplay will be continuously updated. Please look forward to future updates.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments

The following cards have been nerfed:

Gathering Storm

Before adjustment: In this turn, Ryomen gains 2 Power, 3 Shield, and Hunt. Enhance: Ryomen gains Haste when this card is linked to and used.

Adjusted: In this turn, Ryomen gains 2 Power, 1 Shield, and Hunt. Enhance: Ryomen gains Haste when this card is linked to and used.

The following cards have been enhanced:

Wind Charm: Flash

Before adjustment: This card will self-destruct at the end of the turn. Trigger: Automatically plays when Ichimokuren is attacked.

Adjusted: Fast This card will self-destruct at the end of the turn. Trigger: Play automatically when Ichimokuren is attacked.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on June 25, 2025. (Up to twice for each type)

【Croak Chorus Avatar Frame Bundle Available】

· Limited animated avatar frame "Frog Chorus" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time, ending at 24:00 on July 2. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

【Midsummer Night's Dream Card Back Bundle Available】

· The limited dynamic Card Back "A Midsummer Night's Dream" will be available after the maintenance on June 19, 2025. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end at 24:00 on July 2. Players can go to the Jade Shop to purchase it.

Appearances Return

· The Special Basic Card Alternative Arts "Momo · Falling Blossoms - Peach Edition" and "Peacock King - Dance of Divine Prayer" return, and players can purchase them at the Jade Shop.

· The Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Chen · Starry Path at Dusk" returns, and players can purchase it at the Jade Shop.

· The Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Oitsuki·Water Moon·Eclipse Shadow Chase" returns. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

【Doodle Alternative Art Limited-time Return】

· Return Time: From after maintenance on June 19, 2025, to 23:59 on July 2, 2025.

· The returning Doodle Alternative Art includes: "Gomaru Doodle Alternative Art," "Kusa·Pupu Doodle Alternative Art," "Maestro Doodle Alternative Art," "Mouba Doodle Alternative Art," "Yamausagi Doodle Alternative Art," and "Kagewani Doodle Alternative Art"!

· For more details on the graffiti Alternative Art Card designs, players can refer to previous content~

Improvements and Bug Fixes

· When the synergy effect of battle cards can be triggered, the synergy keywords on the cards will be highlighted with a color change.

· Adjusted the pacing of playing Spell cards and Combat cards. Now, when both sides play card effects, subsequent effects and actions will no longer be blocked.

· Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if the opponent's Library had no cards and Alena's Invocation was attached.

· Fixed an issue where defeating an opponent's Shikigami with the ability \[Self-Destruct When Injured] using damage from your side would not trigger your side's \[Defeat Effect]. For example: Saki "Four-Color Violet" and Ibaraki Doji "Rage Outlet."

· Fixed an issue where Kusa·Urupu did not trigger the entry effect of Form Cards obtained through Zashiki \[Fortune's Favor].

· Fixed an issue where players might be unable to close the Battlefield Shop interface after purchasing all items in the shop.

· Fixed an issue where players purchasing cards consecutively in the battlefield shop and using Chiryu "Return to Void" before the cards were added to their hand would cause errors and affect subsequent settlements.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments

The following cards have been enhanced:

Maintenance Time
Add an option during Assault: Lazy Guwa
Moyu Frog: If there is no Guaduo Momentum in the Combat Zone, randomly summon a Guatai, then grant the summoned entity of Onikage the effect "Self-destruct upon taking damage," and restore 2 Health to Onikage.

Gua Cleansing
Before Adjustment: If there is no Guado Multitude in the Combat Zone, randomly Summon a Guatai, then have the Summoned entity of Onikage use its exclusive card, and Onikage takes 3 Damage.
After the adjustment: If there is no Gua Duo Power in the Combat Zone, randomly Summon a Gua Tai, then have the summoned entity of Onro use its exclusive card, causing Onro to take 2 damage.

Gamble	
Before Adjustment: Whenever you use a stack card from your hand, Luck 4: Use another stack card of the same quantity.
Adjusted: Whenever you use a stack card from your hand, Luck 4: Use another stack card of the same quantity. For every 3 Shop cards you use during this game, the required Luck points decrease by 1.

Delion's Promise

Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+0 Health
After the adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+1 Health

Evolve: Kusa
Before the adjustment: When entering the battlefield, trigger Kusa's entering effect of her current form. Evolve: When Kusa uses a different Form Card from her current form, trigger the entering effect of the current form and draw a card.
After the adjustment: When entering the battlefield, trigger Kusa's entering effect of her current form. Evolve: When Kusa uses a Form Card, trigger the entering effect of the current form and draw a card.

Izuna Pact	
Before the adjustment: Reduce Kanko's Countdown by 2.
After the Adjustment: Attach a Vengeful Fox Mark to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone and reduce Kanko's countdown by 2.

Divine Flames of Wrath	
Before the Adjustment: Each of your "Serpent Demons" launches an attack and becomes immune to attack damage.
After the Adjustment: Each of your "Serpent Demons" launches an attack, gains 1 Power, and becomes immune to attack damage.

Wrath of Unwillingness	
Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +1 Power/+0 Shield
After the adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power/+0 Shield

Night of Fear	
Before Adjustment: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, attach Fear to a random opponent Shikigami that is not attached with Fear, and gain 1 Wing of Fear. Wing of Fear is playable when defeated, and can be played on your other Shikigami.
After the adjustment: Upon entering and at the start of your turn, bind "Fear" to a random opponent's Shikigami that is not already bound with "Fear" and gain two "Fear Wings." "Fear Wings" can be used upon being defeated and can target other allied Shikigami. Once per turn, each use of "Fear Wings" on Ten Gyaku increases its effect by 1.

Ace Commander	
Before the Adjustment: During your turn, when your Shikigami uses a Blessing Card or Burst Card, Taki gains Haste, Exaltation, and Barrier. Blessing 3: Taki gains Haste and Exaltation.
Adjusted: When entering the battlefield and when your Shikigami uses a Blessing card or Burst card during your turn, Taki gains Haste, Inspiration, and Barrier. Blessing 3: Taki gains Haste and Inspiration.

Evolve: Chi Li	
Before the adjustment: Discard a card and draw a card. Evolve: Once every turn, when you discard a card, Chi Li charges a matching faction's Flowing Cloud.
After Adjustment: Discard a card and draw two cards. Evolve: Once every turn, when you discard a card, Chi Li charges a matching faction's Flowing Cloud.

Enmusubi of All Things	
Before the Adjustment: Upon entering, randomly add a "Enmusubi Card" to the Shop and attach "Fortune Enmusubi," ensuring it appears in the next refresh. At the start of your Turn, increase the effect of all "Enmusubi Cards" by 1.
After the Adjustment: Upon entering, randomly add an unused "Enmusubi Card" to the Shop and attach "Fortune Enmusubi," ensuring it appears in the next refresh. At the start of your Turn, increase the effect of all "Enmusubi Cards" by 1.

The following cards have been adjusted:

Mist Above the Falls	
Before Adjustment: Repeat 3 times, consume 2 Energy: Choose one Blessing effect of this card. If this card has used three types of Blessing effects, Energy consumption -1. Blessing 4: Restore 4 Health to yourself. Blessing 4: Divine 1, draw a card. Blessing 4: Randomly deal 4 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Blessing 4: Inflict 4 Fragile on the opponent Player.
After the Adjustment: Repeat 3 times, consume 2 Energy: Choose one of this card's Blessing effects. If this card has used three types of Blessing effects, Energy consumption is reduced by 1. Blessing 4: Restore 4 Health to you. Blessing 4: Draw a card and gain 2 Energy. Blessing 4: Randomly deal 4 damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Blessing 4: Inflict 4 Fragile on the opponent's Player.

· Fixed an issue where Shuten Doji/Ibaraki Doji's Reinforce Card "Frenzied Song and Heroic Spirit" would not trigger the effect of "Evolve: Mio."

· Fixed an issue where the description of the Player Match effect "Player Match: Chi Seal" item was incorrect.
· Fixed an issue where, after converting a standard Deck with two identical Reinforce Cards into an unlimited Deck, additional identical Reinforce Cards could be added to the Deck.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami with Substitute ability would remove the attached Karasu Tengu's Autumn Leaves "Divine Power" and "Weakness" Invocations when triggering the Substitute effect.

· Fixed an issue where using Blazing Pupil prevented the count of Bukkuman's Invocation from increasing.
· Fixed an issue where, during Hououka's "Nirvana Purgatory Flames" effect, Empower Cards were not recognized as Level 1 Cards.
· Fixed an issue where Hakuzosu's Invocation "Foxflame: Azure" would still take effect after disappearing.
· Fixed an issue where, when using the Four Dots Alternative Art to attach a Zashiki to Yoto Hime: Cursed Blade, the Zashiki effect would revert to its original effect after Yoto Hime transformed using an Evolve Card.
· Optimized the issue where Ketsu's Gata's arrival caused damage to itself during the assault of the Oboro Car. Now, Gata's arrival no longer increases non-combat damage to allies.

Event Time: From after the maintenance on November 7 to 10:00 on November 21.
In this event, the gameplay of the sealed deck will undergo significant changes:
1. The initial deck building is divided into two rounds. In the first round, you will choose 4 initial Shikigami and receive 5 random cards for each chosen Shikigami. In the second round, two sets of cards for each Shikigami will be displayed, each set containing 3 cards. You will choose one set to complete the Shikigami's 8 cards.

By spending Orbs to explore the map, you can obtain new Shikigami, new cards, and unique collectibles to enhance your abilities. 1. Both players must wager Victory Stars equal to the ante during combat, which increases with each turn.

Shikigami Toughness System Now Available
· Toughness System Introduction
Toughness can, to some extent, represent how long and how well you've used Shikigami. The more times a Shikigami wins and the higher the win rate, the higher its Toughness (Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included)
You can check out each Shikigami's Toughness under Proficiency in Shikigami - Shikigami Details.
Participating in Ranked Match will change Shikigami's Toughness. Winning a match will increase the Toughness of the Shikigami used, while losing a match will decrease the Toughness of the Shikigami used.
In Ranked Match, changes of Toughness are subject to corrections due to factors including Tier, if the Shikigami's Toughness has reached 1000, and how many times the Shikigami has been used during this season.
Participating in Sealed Deck will also change Shikigami's Toughness. At the settlement of Sealed Deck, Shikigami will gain Toughness according to its corresponding wins.
There's no upper limit for Toughness. Toughness above 1000 will be reset partially with season settlement. 1001 - 3000: Reset to 40%; Above 3000: Reset to 20%. (For example, 3200 Toughness will be reset to: 1000+2000×40%+200×20%=1840 Toughness)
· Toughness Rankings
When a Shikigami's Toughness reaches 1000, it is qualified to enter its Toughness Rankings.
Tap "Shikigami" on the left in Ranked Match's Rankings to enter the Shikigami Toughness Rankings. You can also enter the corresponding Shikigami Toughness Rankings in Shikigami Details - Toughness - Check Ranking.
In Shikigami's Toughness Rankings, tap Shikigami's avatar on the left to see all Shikigami's Toughness and rankings.

Each Shikigami can obtain redemption materials for the Toughness card frame when its highest Toughness reaches 1000. Shinkiro Myth: Tales of Wonder Coming Soon!

· The three phases of this time's Tales of Wonder's themes share a common skill selection mechanism:
1. In each match, players can boost their decks by using one of the three skills provided by the system.
2. Players can refresh the skills provided by the system to obtain different ones. The skills can be refreshed freely with a limited number of times, and players can continue to refresh them with Daruma Coins or Gold.
3. The skills can only be refreshed after finishing a battle.
4. Both players' health is 60 while the second player's shield is 10, and Shikigami will be defeated in 2 turns.
· Includes the following themes:
Strategic Move
Time: From after the maintenance on February 9 to 24:00 on February 11.
Duplicates 2X4

Time: From 00:00 on February 15 to 24:00 on February 17

Baizhe Alternative Art Special Pack is on Sale
· The Baizhe Alternative Art Special Pack will be available from after the maintenance on February 9, 2023 to 9:00, February 23, 2023.
· The pack contains Baizhe Basic Card Collector Edition Alternative Art - Reflected Snow, Alternative Art Avatar - Baizhe: Erudite and 50 Ink Jade.
· After the maintenance on February 23, Baizhe Basic Card Collector Edition Alternative Art - Reflected Snow and Baizhe Alternative Art Avatar Pack will be restored to their original prices, and become available in the Alternative Art Shop and Jade Shop respectively. The Baizhe Alternative Art Avatar Pack contains the Alternative Art Avatar Baizhe: Erudite and 50 Ink Jade.

Passing Time Combat Background Now Available
· Live it to the fullest in the ever-passing time. · The Passing Time Combat Background will be available in the Jade Shop on February 9, 2023. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end on 24:00 February 21.

Card Pack PYO Pack Now Available

· Card Pack PYO Special Pack contains Card Pack PYO Pack x2 and Glass Stone x80. Quota: 2; Card Pack PYO Premium Pack contains Card Pack PYO Pack x4 and Glass Stone x140. Quota: 2.
· The packs will be removed at 24:00 on February 22.

PYO SSR Card Pack Now Available
· PYO SSR Card Pack will be available in the Jade Shop from after the maintenance on February 9, 2023 to 24:00 on February 25, 2023. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.
· The pack contains 1 PYO SSR card! Select any Shikigami and gain 1 SSR card of that Shikigami. Possible cards: Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up The Sea, Fortune and Enmusubi, Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Flowers in Slumber, Fleeting Dreams, Noisy Cooking Battle, Paradise Chords, Interwoven Fates, Ethereal Essence series.

Appearances Return

Hyakubun Chess Major Update

notes.title: Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/cdfe987c41a42a8726513d663be7bf213e939776.png

Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on January 18, 2023. 

Ethereal Essence Update Now Available
The new Ethereal Essence data pack of Onmyoji: The Card Game is now available, featuring unique Tactical gameplay and 8 new Shikigami.
· Ethereal Essence Card Packs will be available after the maintenance on January 18, 2023. 
· The card pack includes 8 new Shikigami: Baizhe, Chocho, Jorogumo, Sparrow, Garuda, Bakekujira, Kagewani, and Fukengaku.
· The 8 Shikigami of the Ethereal Essence Card Pack are now all available. More Shikigami will be obtainable from new Card Packs or by other means in the future.
· After the new Ethereal Essence data pack becomes available on January 18, guests will be able to claim 3 free Ethereal Essence Card Packs by logging into the game. 
· The Ethereal Essence Card Pack rebate event will be available after the maintenance on January 18, 2023 until 24:00 of February 8, 2023. During the event, when purchasing any 10 card packs with Jade, players will get 1 free Ethereal Essence Card Pack, up to 5 packs. 

Ethereal Essence Data Pack Adjustments
· Added the Master Collector title for the Ethereal Essence data pack. 
· Changed the requirement of the Supreme Collector title to collecting all the cards of 131 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included). 
· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all the Inked cards of 131 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all the Inked cards of 131 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· The Ethereal Essence Card Pack can now be purchased in the Hyakubun Scrollery.
· Added 8 new Shikigami of the Ethereal Essence data pack to Sealed Deck. 
· The card pack rewards from Sealed Deck will include Ethereal Essence Card Packs. The random card rewards will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Ethereal Essence data pack. 
· The rewards of Kaidan Chapter 1, 2 will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Ethereal Essence data pack.
· Ethereal Essence Card Pack will be available for selection in Card Pack PYO Pack after the update on January 18.

The Penglai Mirage Event Is Now Available!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on January 18, 2023 to 24:00 on February 1, 2023
Event Description:
· During the event, players can spend Mirage Compasses to explore and unlock all locations in the Penglai Wonderland, following three groups of different Shikigami to help Baizhe break her seal. Players can also receive 10 Ethereal Essence Card Packs during the course of exploration.
· The progress of the three routes in the event is independent of each other. However, players must complete the previous story to unlock the story in a certain route. The past stories of Baizhe will be gradually unlocked as the exploration progresses. Unlocking Baizhe's stories does not cost Mirage Compass.
· Players can obtain a certain amount of Jasper Crystals for every story they complete.
· When challenging the depth of Penglai Wonderland, players can bring up to 4 skills obtained when unlocking stories to help them in the challenge.
· In addition, the event also features six challenge quests, completing them will grant a large amount of Jasper Crystals.
· Players can use Jasper Crystals to redeem Limited Transition Wallpaper: Penglai's Spirit, Limited Title: Erudite and Informed, Limited Avatar Frame: Harmonious Jade, Baizhe's Special Alternative Art: Connecting of Karma, 40 Ink Jades, Glass Stones, and more.
· Complete event quests to obtain Mirage Compasses.

Ethereal Essence Pack is on Sale
· Ethereal Essence Special Card Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on January 18, 2023, containing 30 Ethereal Essence Card Packs.
· Ethereal Essence Welcome Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on January 18, 2023, containing 10 Ethereal Essence Card Packs.

Limited Free Festival for All Cards
· Event Time: From February 4, 2023, 00:00 to February 5, 2023, 24:00
· During the event, players can try all cards of Shikigami from the Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up the Sea, Fortune and Enmusubi, Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Flowers in Slumber, Fleeting Dreams, Noisy Cooking Battle, Paradise Chords, Interwoven Fates, Ethereal Essence Card Packs (excludes Alternative Art Cards, and all cards of Kyonshi Imoto).

Taishakuten: Holy Child Alternative Art Now Available
Special Form Card Alternative Art Taishakuten: Holy Child will be available after the maintenance on January 18, 2023 with a limited-time discount. Guests can purchase it in the Alternative Art Shop. The limited-time offer will end at 24:00 on February 1, 2023.

Unlock Shikigami System Available
· After the maintenance on January 18, 2023, the Unlock Shikigami system will be available for players to unlock Shikigami and build decks more conveniently.
· Players can spend 15,000 Gold to unlock any Shikigami and obtain its basic cards through this system. 
· The entrance of Unlock Shikigami is on the right of Card in Shikigami.

Alternative Art Takes Turns to Discount: Ninth Turn Begins
· Many Alternative Arts which have been sold for over one year will enjoy a discount for a limited time during each turn, guests can head to the Alternative Art Shop to purchase them!
· Available time during this turn: From 10:00 on January 21, 2023 to 9:00 on March 11, 2023.
· Discounted Alternative Art during this turn: Fujihime: Script Writer, Matsu: Outline Dream and Mind, Yoto Hime: Yoto Kaleido, Higanbana: Crimson Flowers, Yuki: Child of Snow, Itsumade: Wandering Feathers.

New Year Special Pack Now Available
· The New Year Special Pack will be available after the maintenance on January 18, 2023 and be sold permanently at a 20% discount.
Contains New Year Avatar - Komatsu, Limited Avatar Frame - Auspicious Orange, and Ink Jade x50.
· The pack will be permanently available, and won't be sold separately in the future.

Balance Adjustments
· The following cards have been enhanced:

Evolve: Ootengu
The description of the ability is unchanged.
Ootengu's Countdown -1.
Evolve: After Ootengu plays a non-Evolve Spell card, Countdown 1: Cast the same spell again.
After the adjustment, the effect of Countdown -1 will be triggered after evolving.

Nitaro's Halberd
Changed the effect to
After dealing damage to an opponent unit, inflict 2 Fragile.
Burst 3: Play Santaro's Axe additionally.

Ichitaro's Kanabo
Changed the effect to
After dealing damage to an opponent unit, stun the unit and reduce its Power to 0 during this turn.
Burst 3: Play Nitaro's Halberd additionally.
Burst 6: Play Santaro's Axe additionally.

Light of Healing
Changed the effect to
Fast
When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, recover 2 Health for all your Shikigami.

Light of Courage
Changed the effect to
Fast
When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, Rally: Gain +2 Power.

Light of Tranquility
Changed the effect to
Fast
When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, you gain 1 Orb.

· The following cards have been adjusted:

Evolve: Chin
Changed the effect to
Inflict 2 Fragile on the opponent player.
Evolve: Countdown 2: Inflict 2 Fragile on the opponent player. This effect +1 for every time you trigger Chin's Basic Ability during this game. (Also effective on the battlefield)

Morus' Blessing
Bloodrippers - SR
Changed the effect to
Kurumi launches an attack. Gain immunity to attack damage and +3 Power during this attack.

Bloodrippers - SSR
Changed the effect to
Kurumi launches an attack. Gain immunity to attack damage and +6 Power during this attack.

Spirit Blade Form
Changed the effect to
Haste, Substitute
When Wuchen charges or moves, deal 10 damage to a charged opponent Shikigami at random. If there's no charged opponent Shikigami, deal 3 damage to an opponent unit at random.

Blackout
Changed the effect to
When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, gain 1 Combat Card Tarka Ji played in this game at random. All Tarka Ji's cards gain Fast, and Tarka Ji becomes immune to non-attack damage and instant defeat when he is in the combat zone.

Kusa
Change the basic ability to
When Kusa uses a different Form Card from her current form, draw a card.

Evolve: Kusa
Changed the Level to 2.
Changed the basic boost to: +1 Power/+1 Health.
Changed the effect to
Evolve: Your Shikigami's Form Card gains Fast, and you can draw a card when it is played.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on January 24, 2023. (Up to twice for each type)

Other Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Adjusted the description of the following cards (The actual effect does not change)
Evolve: Dodomeki
Change the description to
Divination 2
Evolve: Whenever your Shikigami Divine, Projectile: Deal X damage, where X is equal to the number of Divination cards.

Strength In Numbers
Change the description to
When entering the battlefield, Kamaitachi gains 1 Power for every 2 Energy.

Maestro
Change of basic ability description:
Countdown 3: Recover 3 Health to all your units. When you play a Maestro's Evolve Spell Card, Maestro's Countdown -3.

Evolve: Entry
Change of ability description:
Evolve: Countdown 3: Deal 4 damage randomly split among the opponent units. When you play a Maestro's Evolve Spell Card, Maestro's Countdown -3.

Evolve: Kagura
Change of ability description:
Evolve: Countdown 3: Your other Shikigami's Countdown -1 and gain 1 Power and 1 Health. When you play a Maestro's Evolve Spell Card, Maestro's Countdown -3.

Evolve: Requiem
Change of ability description:
Evolve: Countdown 3: Draw a card, gain 1 Orb. When you play a Maestro's Evolve Spell Card, Maestro's Countdown -3.

· Fixed an issue where Evolved Kamaitachi fails to assault when they have Haste and Soaring, but no Orbs or assault attempts.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami at the Combat Zone wrongly assault when your Shikigami with Soaring assault and you have 0 assault attempt and Enraged Shikigami.

*The next maintenance day is February 9.
